summary: All eleven phases are merged into main in every target repo, and each acceptance criterion V01–V20 has delivered work behind it: the inventory and rulings page (P4), the guide's rules and 14 linted reference files (P5, P6), the reference pages and their witnessed-red test (P3), the site, image and job (P2, P9), the deploy repo and the two registrations (P8, P10, P11), the skill (P7), and the §6a test (P1). V19 holds, since only vars/podYaml.groovy changed (the ruled aac-tools template, c4de566), and all six test classes still run (V20). What remains is the test phase's by the plan's own Ordering constraints: the pushes, the first builds of IaC/JenkinsPipelineUtils and AaC/PipelinesDeploy, the Architecture push after that build, and the site-live check (V12–V14, V16). Every open close-out entry is a sub-bar content fix or an operator call that the wrap-up or the operator handles; none is plan-owed work. I added context notes to P7 and P8.
